lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-intensity spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features across the upper dorsal flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.
